paragraphs: Chattermill’s mission to turn every customer touchpoint into actionable insight mirrors my own focus on extracting meaning from unstructured data at scale.
I built NLP and agentic RAG workflows with Hugging Face Transformers, Ollama, LangChain and LangGraph, enabling rapid retrieval and generation of context‑aware responses.
I developed an XGBoost churn classifier in R using tidymodels, applying a two‑stage Bayesian hyperparameter search, SMOTE within the recipe, and MCC for evaluation.
